scope: Additive access-management audit log for portal user, role, project, and form assignment changes. This schema does not enable portal writes by itself.
source_model: Portal User & Access management with Power Pages role-gated administration and Dataverse audit persistence.

tables.name: AccessAuditLogs
tables.purpose: Append-only audit record for every attempted or completed User & Access change.

columns.name: AuditKey
columns.notes: Stable event key. Recommended format: access:{utcTimestamp}:{actorEmail}:{action}:{affectedEmail}:{requestId}.

columns.name: Action
columns.notes: Business action being audited.

columns.name: ResultStatus
columns.notes: Outcome of the attempted operation.

columns.name: ActorEmail
columns.notes: Signed-in administrator email from the Power Pages session.

columns.name: ActorContact
columns.notes: Power Pages contact for the administrator when available.

columns.name: ActorRolesJson
columns.notes: Snapshot of detected Power Pages roles used for route/action authorization.

columns.name: AffectedEmail
columns.notes: Email of the user whose access is being changed.

columns.name: AffectedContact
columns.notes: Power Pages contact for the affected user when available.

columns.name: TargetRole
columns.notes: Target business role label, for example Data Collector / Bank Officer.

columns.name: ScopeType
columns.notes: Scope touched by the change.

columns.name: Project
columns.notes: Project scope when the change is project-scoped.

columns.name: Form
columns.notes: Form scope when the change affects a form.

columns.name: FormVersion
columns.notes: Form version scope when assignment is version-specific.

columns.name: FormAssignment
columns.notes: Assignment row touched by the access change when available.

columns.name: PreviousStateJson
columns.notes: Before snapshot of relevant assignment/contact/role fields. Required by policy for mutation actions.

columns.name: NewStateJson
columns.notes: After snapshot of relevant assignment/contact/role fields. Required by policy for mutation actions.

columns.name: Reason
columns.notes: Business reason entered by the administrator before the change is submitted.

columns.name: SourceRoute
columns.notes: Portal route/action source, for example UserAccess:AddUser or UserAccess:Suspend.

columns.name: RequestId
columns.notes: Client-generated operation id used to correlate access mutation and audit records.

columns.name: CorrelationId
columns.notes: Optional server, flow, or Dataverse correlation id when available.

columns.name: RollbackOf
columns.notes: Original audit event being rolled back when Action is RollbackAccessChange.

columns.name: OccurredAt
columns.notes: UTC timestamp when the administrator requested or completed the action.

columns.name: ResultMessage
columns.notes: Short failure, rejection, or post-action note. Must not contain secrets or raw tokens.

relationships.notes: Assignment row touched by the audited operation.

alternate_keys.name: ak_access_audit_log
alternate_keys.notes: Stable audit event key for idempotent audit persistence.

alternate_keys.name: ak_access_audit_request
alternate_keys.notes: Prevents duplicate audit rows for the same portal operation request.
